verdict.rationale: Cake ships an MCP server (docs-11/12/26/27) letting AI assistants like Claude/Cursor query live cap table data (shareholders, vesting, option pool, SAFEs) read-only, which covers the 'pull cap table programmatically' half of the story. However there is no evidence of data-room integration or any reconciliation feature comparing cap table data against data-room documents. Missing for 10: data room integration/API, reconciliation logic or diff/compare feature, and any explicit financing-workflow tie-in beyond capital-raise modelling.
